verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਮਨੂਰ ਮਲੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur paaras parasiaai ka(n)chan karai manoor maleenaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is such a philosopher's stone by whose touch dross transforms into gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਵਨੁ ਚੰਦਨੋ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਲਾਖੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur baavan cha(n)dhano vaas suvaas karai laakheenaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that sandalwood which makes every thing fragrant and million times more precious .

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਰਿਜਾਤੁ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur pooraa paarijaat si(n)mal safal karai sa(n)g leenaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that wish fulfilling tree which makes the cotton silk tree full of fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾਗਹੁ ਹੰਸ ਜਲਹੁ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: maan sarovar satiguroo kaagahu ha(n)s jalahu dhudh peenaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that Manasarovar, the sacred lake in Hindu mythology, which transforms crows into swans, who drink milk cut of mixtrue of water and milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਹੈ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਕਰੈ ਪਰਬੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: gur teerath dhareeaau hai pasoo paret karai parabeenaa|

en.bdb: The Guru is that holy river which makes the animals and the ghosts knowledgeable and skilful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੰਦੀਛੋੜੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਵਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਓਡੀਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur ba(n)dheechhoR hai jeevan mukat karai oddeenaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is giver of freedom from bondages and makes the detached ones librated in life.
The wavering mind of the Guru-oriented individual becomes steadfast and full of confidence.
